## 8. Summary Card Pattern

Don't use 3 identical generic cards. Vary the treatment: column widths such as `1.1fr 1fr 0.9fr`, a white background with a 1px hairline border and 6px radius, no `box-shadow`. Markup and the card-dot variants: [layout-budget.md § Summary Card Pattern](../../upstream/references/layout-budget.md#summary-card-pattern).
